findings.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
findings.question: Does the edited image show the original mug moved to the right of the headphones, rather than merely showing a mug on the right while the original mug remains elsewhere?
findings.criteria: Compare source and edited images to track the source mug and determine whether its position changed to the headphones’ right. A right-side mug alone does not establish that the requested move occurred.
findings.evidence: The source shows one blue mug left of the headphones. The edited image appears to show a blue blurred shape left of the headphones and a separate mug on the right; the right-side mug is not clearly the source mug.
findings.rationale: The saved check establishes only the final relative placement of a visible mug and headphones. It does not investigate object continuity or whether the source mug was moved; the edited image raises a concrete possibility that the original mug remains left while another mug appears right. This is an evidence question, not a conclusion about fulfillment.
